label: prop:degree-two-baryon-weight
title: Degree-2 weight $\beta_2 = -2[3]_q$ from baryon quantum number
html:
Proposition. Degree-2 weight \beta_2 = -2[3]_q from baryon quantum number

The coefficient of \Phi_2 in the Wedderburn mass formula is

  \beta_2 = -2[3]_q
          = -2 \cdot \frac{q^3 - q^{-3}}{q - q^{-1}}
          \approx -6.087

where [3]_q is the quantum 3-integer.
